code: export function parseOperatorAssignments(rawOperators){let numOperations=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:0;const fallback={};if(!rawOperators)return fallback;try{const parsed=JSON.parse(rawOperators);const map={};if(Array.isArray(parsed)){parsed.forEach((item,index)=>{if(typeof item==='string'){map[index+1]=item.trim();return;}if(item&&typeof item==='object'){const op=Number(item.numOperacion)||Number(item.num_operacion)||Number(item.operacion)||index+1;const name=String(item.operador||item.nombre||item.name||'').trim();if(op>0&&name){map[op]=name;}}});}return map;}catch(_unused){const names=String(rawOperators).split(',').map(name=>name.trim()).filter(Boolean);if(names.length===0)return fallback;const totalOps=Math.max(Number(numOperations)||names.length,1);const map={};for(let op=1;op<=totalOps;op+=1){map[op]=names[(op-1)%names.length];}return map;}}export function getOperatorForOperation(rawOperators,numOperations,operationNumber){const map=parseOperatorAssignments(rawOperators,numOperations);return map[operationNumber]||'Sin asignar';}export function getOperatorsSummary(rawOperators,numOperations){const map=parseOperatorAssignments(rawOperators,numOperations);const unique=[...new Set(Object.values(map).filter(Boolean))];return unique.length>0?unique.join(', '):'Sin asignar';}
